Question:
Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        CASE WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 12.0 ELSE 10.0 END as base_price,
        COALESCE(SUM(pge.extras_count), 0) as extra_count
    FROM pizza_customer_orders co
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_runner_orders pro ON co.order_id = pro.order_id
    LEFT JOIN pizza_get_extras pge ON co.order_id = pge.order_id
    WHERE pn.pizza_name IN ('Meatlovers', 'Vegetarian')
    AND (pro.cancellation IS NULL OR pro.cancellation = '')
    GROUP BY co.order_id, pn.pizza_name
)
SELECT 
    SUM(base_price) as base_price_total,
    SUM(extra_count) as extra_charge_total,
    SUM(base_price + extra_count) as total_income
FROM order_totals

    pn.pizza_name,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 12.0
            WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Vegetarian' THEN 10.0
            ELSE 0
        END
        + CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(co.extras, '') = '' THEN 0
            ELSE (LENGTH(co.extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(co.extras, ',', '')) + 1)

    ) as revenue
FROM pizza_customer_orders co
JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders cro ON co.order_id = cro.order_id
WHERE pn.pizza_name IN ('Meatlovers', 'Vegetarian')
